problems_addressed.specific_problem: Agents losing deals due to lack of follow-up
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Consistently communicate with clients daily, even if there's no update, to maintain engagement and trust.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Fear of AI replacing real estate agents

episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the critical importance of daily client communication to prevent lost deals and build stronger relationships. He also explores the role of AI in real estate, emphasizing that while AI can enhance efficiency, it cannot replace the emotional intelligence and personal touch that agents provide. The conversation provides actionable insights for agents and team leaders to improve their client management and leverage technology effectively.
